profile.name: Vishwakanth S
profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer | React, Next.js, Node.js & AI-Powered Systems
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with 5.6+ years of experience building web and mobile products across React, React Native, Next.js, Nest.js and Node.js, with strong SQL/NoSQL data modeling, cloud deployment on GCP and AWS, and applied AI fluency including Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems.

experience.company: Maghilhub Pvt Ltd (Alice Brisque Pvt Ltd)
experience.summary: Full-stack development across a merchant-facing web portal and companion mobile apps for merchants and customers.
Frontend developer on the Toyota Smart Path project, building dealer-specific enterprise applications for Toyota Financial Services.
responsibilities: Developed dealer-specific enterprise applications for Toyota Financial Services using React and Next.js, delivering responsive, pixel-perfect UIs.
Collaborated with design, backend, and product teams to align business logic and improve overall user experience.
Implemented and maintained CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Docker, GitHub Actions) for automated integration and deployment to AWS environments.
Optimized front-end performance, conducted code reviews, and contributed in Agile ceremonies for efficient feature delivery.

experience.summary: Led development of payroll and HR modules for ZenyoPayroll, an HR management platform.
responsibilities: Developed payroll and HR modules including dashboard, employee info, payslip handling, IT declarations, and loan management.
Deployed mobile apps to Play Store and App Store, ensuring smooth cross-platform functionality.
Conducted unit testing and wrote module documentation to maintain code quality and clarity.
Collaborated with team members to implement features efficiently, ensuring timely delivery.

experience.summary: Built core HR management modules for ZenyoWorkforce.
responsibilities: Built key modules including dashboard, employee management, timesheet & expense tracking, and onboarding/offboarding.
Implemented push notifications to improve user engagement across platforms.
Assisted in app deployment to Play Store and App Store, handling release builds and configuration.
Worked closely with the team to develop and integrate features, maintaining smooth project progress.

experience.summary: Progressed from Intern to Senior Developer on Zenbasket, an e-commerce platform, over 2.5 years.
responsibilities: Delivered core modules: product, cart, options, customer, discounts, and order management.
Enhanced platform functionality with Redux state management and dynamic animations.
Scaled platform using TypeScript and Higher-Order Components (HOCs), improving maintainability and adaptability.
Collaborated in Agile teams to implement features efficiently and support platform growth.
achievements: Outstanding Contributor of the Year – Centizen Inc, 2022
Out of Box Thinker – Centizen Inc, 2021
